warning_source: Alon Davidi; Ofir Libstein; Tamir Idan; Itamar Revivo; Gadi Yarkoni — Gaza-envelope local-authority heads
recipient: Benjamin Netanyahu — Prime Minister and Defense Minister
warning_summary: Warned that weakening the National Emergency Authority and transferring responsibilities to Home Front Command could cause irreversible damage to the Gaza envelope, delay lifesaving protection projects and endanger residents' lives.
evidence_state: Resolved with two independent contemporaneous sources: Shaharit 2 Aug 2019 names the five signatories, Netanyahu as recipient and quotes the warning; Globes 6 Aug 2019 independently quotes the life-safety warning and documents the Defense Ministry response. Shakuf/HaMakom 18 Oct 2023 retrospectively corroborate the same chain and Tamir Idan's contemporaneous Radio Darom complaints.
gaps: Original signed letter and exact dispatch date remain unrecovered; no personal Netanyahu reply located. Best-known warning date recorded as 1 Aug 2019 with uncertainty preserved.
run_note: Older-warning candidate crossed threshold and is already published in Notion as WARN-140. Canonical Accepted count now 138.

warning_source: IDF General Staff camp-defense inspection / Gaza Division posts
recipient: Named qualifying senior recipient not established
warning_summary: A General Staff camp-defense inspection found severe access-control and physical-security failures at almost all tested Gaza Division posts; at Nahal Oz inspectors reportedly entered unauthorized areas, reached operations/observation rooms and removed weapons, sensitive material and an armory key.
evidence_state: N12 documentary reporting and independent Times of Israel reporting establish the 4 Oct inspection and findings. IDF response described it as a routine base-defense audit, not a simulation of a mass surprise attack.
gaps: Need the internal inspection report/minutes and evidence that findings were delivered before 7 Oct to a named qualifying senior state/security decision-maker. Current public evidence does not establish pre-attack senior receipt.
run_note: Lane-6 documentary-recovery audit; warning/vulnerability content is strong but recipient threshold remains unmet, so not Accepted.

recipient: Military Intelligence / Unit 8200 senior officials reported; exact named qualifying recipient and dates unresolved
warning_summary: Months before Oct 7, Air Force officers reportedly warned that their intelligence picture was incomplete and complained that Unit 8200 was retaining intelligence, analysis and assessments instead of sharing them; several senior meetings and a cooperation plan reportedly followed.
evidence_state: N12 retrospective investigation reports the complaint and follow-up meetings; later reporting says the last meeting was roughly a week before the attack. Public Turgeman/IAF inquiry summaries do not independently publish this exact warning chain.
gaps: Need contemporaneous complaint/email/minutes, named sender/recipient, exact meeting dates and independent official corroboration. Retrospective reporting alone is insufficient for acceptance under the library standard.

recipient: Netanyahu/government publicly addressed; direct delivery/receipt not established
warning_summary: After a Hezbollah anti-tank incident, northern local leaders publicly warned that hundreds of thousands of residents lacked adequate protection, some communities effectively had no warning time, and demanded immediate release of the stalled northern-protection budget.
evidence_state: Contemporaneous News13 and Israel Hayom reporting document the warning content and the public demand to Netanyahu/government; later budget records confirm the protection-program context.
gaps: No direct letter, meeting record or other evidence found showing the warning was delivered to and received by a named qualifying senior decision-maker. Publicity alone does not satisfy receipt rules.
